description: Establish the baseline and a fresh feature branch off main before any code changes. This is an existing project; confirm the current test suite is green so later regressions are attributable.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/Autosurveryai confirm the current branch is main and the working tree is clean of source changes (the untracked .agents/tasks/ and mockup.html are expected and may remain).
Create and check out a new branch off main named feat/per-match-ranking (do NOT push).
Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and confirm all 37 tests pass.
Run `node tests/test_ui.cjs` and confirm it prints its success lines and exits 0.
Record the baseline counts in this feature's findings.
acceptance_criteria: A new local branch feat/per-match-ranking exists and is checked out, created from main.
`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` reports OK with 37 tests.
verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v  => OK (37 tests)
findings: Baseline confirmed green off main (commit 1341228, PR #3). Created and checked out branch feat/per-match-ranking. `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` => OK, Ran 37 tests in ~2.1s. `node tests/test_ui.cjs` => printed Round 1 + Round 2 UI success lines and exited 0. Working tree had only expected untracked files (.agents/tasks/ and mockup.html); no source changes before branching. Python 3 and Node v22 preinstalled, no deps needed.
